recommendations.description: Conduct a claims-processing and contractual reprocessing audit for PPO Local and Medicare GRS AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION and Not Mapped facility claims in GA, CA, ME, NY, OH, CT, and NH; reconcile authorization records to inpatient and post-acute claims for Good Samaritan Hospital, AdventHealth Palm Coast Parkway, Aftercare with CC/MCC, Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, Cellulitis without MCC, and Miscellaneous Disorders of Nutrition, Metabolism, and Fluids and Electrolytes with MCC, then reprocess mismatched claims.
evidence: Validation needed because increase is tied to authorization-code movement and unmapped facility buckets.
GA authorization-code movement added about $2.2M.
CA authorization-code movement added about $0.9M.
Not Mapped facility claims concentrated at Good Samaritan Hospital and AdventHealth Palm Coast Parkway.
PPO Local and Medicare GRS inpatient and post-acute claims are impacted.

recommendations.description: Conduct a CA PPO Local provider-specific contract compliance and site-of-care review at Good Samaritan Hospital and California Rehabilitation Institute for Aftercare with CC/MCC, Aftercare, Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue with CC, and Miscellaneous Disorders of Nutrition, Metabolism, and Fluids and Electrolytes with MCC, validating PA-to-claim matching, rehab placement, discharge timing, and DRG coding on rare spine and trauma episodes.
evidence: Aftercare with CC/MCC rose in CA Physical Rehab with more admissions and higher paid/admit.
Aftercare, Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue with CC rose in CA Acute Hospital.
HYPO-OSMOLALITY AND HYPONATREMIA repeatedly drove electrolyte-related inpatient spend.
Good Samaritan Hospital appears repeatedly in concentrated high-cost CA episodes.
Most major operational drivers were PA-required and flagged for auth-to-claim validation.
Rare spine and trauma cases were single-case high paid admissions.

recommendations.description: Review GA PPO Local inpatient policy for UTI SITE NOT SPECIFIED, ACUTE CYSTITIS WITHOUT HEMATURIA, CELLULITIS OF LEFT LOWER LIMB, and Aftercare with CC/MCC by auditing Emory Hospital Perry and GA acute hospital and Physical Rehab claims for admission criteria, discharge routing, site-of-care, contract compliance, PA enforcement, and manual-adjudication edits.
evidence: UTI SITE NOT SPECIFIED led GA clinical concentration.
ACUTE CYSTITIS WITHOUT HEMATURIA appears among key driver codes.
Cellulitis without MCC concentrated in lower-limb diagnoses.
Aftercare with CC/MCC increased in GA Physical Rehab.
Emory Hospital Perry appears in GA acute hospital provider concentration.
PA-required acute hospital and rehab cards are present.

recommendations.description: Implement a targeted OH inpatient policy review for PPO Local and Medicare HMO acute hospital and physical rehab admissions: audit initial and concurrent review KPIs, confirm discharge-to-rehab criteria and prior authorization was obtained, and validate authorization-to-claim matching for Aftercare with CC/MCC, Aftercare, Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue with CC, DSPL IT FX RT FEMUR SUB CLOS FX RTN, and ENC FOR OTHER ORTHOPEDIC AFTERCARE.
evidence: OH cost growth is primarily volume-led, not broad price escalation.
OH physical rehab added 17 PPO Local admissions; paid per admit fell.
OH acute hospital added admissions across electrolyte disorders, UTI, and cellulitis.
Orthopedic aftercare and femur fracture drivers added spend in musculoskeletal aftercare with CC.
A smaller Medicare HMO rehab cell added one admission.
Most key operational cells show PA required equals Y.

recommendations.description: Conduct a joint prior-authorization-to-claim and reimbursement audit for KY PPO Local Medicare GRS ACUTE HOSPITAL admissions with pa_required_code = Y to verify authorized inpatient level of care matched actual diagnosis/DRG/service billed and confirm claims processed per contractual obligation.
evidence: KY acute hospital spend rose about $1.0M in PPO Local.
Admissions increased by 49 and claims increased by 55.
Paid per admit rose by about $1.2K.
PA required code is Y.
Paid ratio stayed essentially unchanged.
peer_benchmarking: United Health policy excludes inpatient DRG-based acute admissions; only professional surgical billing is addressed.

recommendations.description: Initiate a focused policy audit for PA-required PPO Local inpatient admissions in OH, PA, ME, and CT across Acute Hospital, Physical Rehab, Critical Access, and Long Term Care Hospital to validate authorization-to-claim matching, confirm reimbursement is processing to contract, and pursue provider and site-of-care remediation for WELLSPAN EPHRATA COMMUNITY HOSPITAL and recurring Aftercare and Cellulitis admissions.
evidence: PA-required PPO Local admissions increased across acute, rehab, critical access, and LTCH settings.
WELLSPAN EPHRATA COMMUNITY HOSPITAL is a named acute hospital outlier.
Aftercare, cellulitis, and metabolic disorder episodes recur in smaller segments.
High paid per admit is concentrated in localized low-count admissions.
ME critical access and CT long term care show recurring outliers.

recommendations.description: Initiate focused clinical validation, program-integrity, and case-management review for Good Samaritan Hospital, Emory Hospital Perry, AdventHealth Palm Coast Parkway, and California Rehabilitation Institute across Infectious and Parasitic Diseases with O.R. Procedures with MCC, Hip and Femur Procedures Except Major Joint with MCC, Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC, Respiratory Infections and Inflammations with MCC, and Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC; validate diagnosis and DRG assignment, audit authorization enforcement, review discharge step-down planning, and evaluate provider contract or site-of-care action.
evidence: Paid per admit increased while volume was not material.
Good Samaritan Hospital concentrated sepsis O.R. outlier admissions.
California Rehabilitation Institute appears in OH fracture rehab outlier episodes.
All cited cards show pa_required_code Y.
Cards repeatedly flag small_n_admissions and repeated_delta_concentration.
peer_benchmarking: Buckeye Health Plan may request pre/post-pay records to validate sepsis and DRG documentation.
Centene may request records validating sepsis, organ dysfunction, SOFA, and treatment.
Molina requires supporting medical records, correct coding, and sepsis evidence.
United Health states accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis coding is required.
